audience: estate and letting agents who manage properties, applicants and viewings in Street.co.uk

useCases.title: List booked viewings and the applicants
useCases.text: The AI lists viewings with property, applicant, time, status and feedback, so you see what is booked and who is coming.

useCases.title: Find hot sales applicants with overdue follow-ups
useCases.text: The AI lists sales applicants with budget, areas and lead rating, and follow-ups with due dates, so you see who needs a call.

useCases.title: Review properties, offers and sales in progress
useCases.text: The AI lists properties with status and price, sales and lettings offers, and sales progression records, so you see what is under offer.

useCases.title: Check tenancies, inspections and maintenance jobs
useCases.text: The AI lists tenancies with rent and dates, property inspections with due and booked dates, and maintenance jobs with status and assignee.

useCases.title: Record an enquiry or add a note to a record
useCases.text: The AI records an inbound enquiry tied to a property or applicant, or adds a note to a person, property, applicant, sale or viewing.

useCases.title: Create a task, follow-up or maintenance request
useCases.text: The AI creates a task for a user, schedules a follow-up on a property, applicant, sale or valuation, or logs a maintenance request against a property.
